title: Implement Aisle Alias Lookup
description: Implement the alias-aware, case-insensitive `aisle(for:)` lookup over canonical and alias tokens, returning the first matching section in declaration order.
acceptance_criteria: The first matching section is returned when tokens appear in multiple sections.

handoff_summary.completed: Updated `aisle(for:)` to normalize the input ingredient and compare it case-insensitively against both canonical tokens and aliases while still using `sections.first` to preserve declaration-order precedence.
handoff_summary.risks: Lookup normalization currently uses simple `lowercased()` matching and does not add whitespace or locale-specific normalization beyond case folding.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Change is isolated to lookup behavior in `AisleConfig.swift`; downstream agents touching the same file should preserve the explicit `return` and case-insensitive comparisons.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used per-call lowercase normalization for the queried ingredient and token comparisons inside the existing linear search to keep behavior local, preserve declaration order, and avoid widening scope into parser/model changes.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Did not run any test suite per guardrails. Verified Swift syntax with `swiftc -typecheck` using a writable module cache under `/private/tmp`.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Matching is case-insensitive only; it does not normalize punctuation, pluralization, or surrounding whitespace beyond whatever the caller/parser already provides.

conflict_risks: Low. Change is isolated to lookup behavior in `AisleConfig.swift`; downstream agents touching the same file should preserve the explicit `return` and case-insensitive comparisons.

execution_history.summary: Implemented alias-aware, case-insensitive aisle lookup in AisleConfig, preserving first-match section order and nil for unmatched ingredients.
